name: agentic/hero-banner
title: Hero Banner
description: Full-width image banner with an optional eyebrow, heading, optional subheading, and CTA. Set `slides` (2+) for a peek carousel; a single slide renders with no carousel chrome. Each slide can set its own `contentAlign` ("left"/"center"/"right") to put its text on either side of the slide — e.g. alternating left/right across slides — falling back to the block-level `contentAlign` when omitted. Each slide can also set `accentColor` (a theme.json palette slug) to tint the CTA button to match a photo's dominant color instead of the default dark button — omit it for the original behavior. A slide can set `videoUrl` (mp4) and optionally `videoWebmUrl` (webm, tried first — smaller, preferred where supported) to play a looping muted background video instead of a static image; `imageUrl` is still required alongside it as the `<video>` poster and as the CSS background shown until the video has buffered. Use real compressed video here, never an animated GIF — GIFs of any real length are megabytes where an equivalent h264/vp9 clip is hundreds of KB, and Lighthouse's `efficient-animated-content` audit fails a GIF outright.
